scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration && bun run test:resilience
scripts.test:concurrency: bun scripts/test-integration.ts --test-name-pattern "50 envios paralelos|duas apostas de 80|carteiras distintas progridem|recebido antes da BET|dois processos publicam|queda após commit"
scripts.validate:static: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck
scripts.validate: bun run validate:static && bun run test
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests test-console package.json tsconfig.json compose.yaml compose.resilience.yaml README.md ARCHITECTURE.md .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests test-console package.json tsconfig.json compose.yaml compose.resilience.yaml README.md ARCHITECTURE.md .prettierrc.json
